body:
## Goal

The website must show every job from the hh.ru CV, with the same facts, and generate a CV for the chosen position, in the chosen language, theme and style.

Sources compared (22 Oct 2026): the hh.ru resume (updated 12 Oct 2026), LinkedIn, and `src/data/profile.js`.

## 1. Data comparison (hh.ru vs website)

LinkedIn matches hh.ru in dates; its titles are noted where they differ.

| Company | hh.ru | Website now | What to fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Evirma** (evirma.ru) | May 2026 – present, **Tech Lead** | missing | Add (see details below) |
| **Capico LLC** (capico.app, Tbilisi) | Nov 2025 – May 2026, **Senior Software Engineer** | missing | Add (see details below) |
| **Kaiten** (kaiten.ru) | Jul 2024 – **Nov 2025**, **Development Team Lead** (led 5 senior developers) | Jul 2024 – **present**, Senior Software Engineer | End date Nov 2025; role Team Lead; add team of 5 seniors, iOS/Android apps, billing system, developer tooling; add `lead` role |
| **Deep.Foundation** | **Sep 2022** – Jun 2024, Co-founder, CTO | **Jul 2020** – Jun 2024 | Start Sep 2022 (or explain the earlier open-source start in the summary). Add: S3-compatible storage, Habr articles and videos, link-network visualization, the demo projects (GPT-4o Discord bot, news analytics, Deep.Memo, Deep.Me, Deep.Chain, JS execution bot, Russian-law search bot with full-text + vector search, Deep.GPT, smart shop with voice/text storefront) |
| **Abracar (ShakeApp)** | Jul 2020 – Aug 2022, Programmer (LinkedIn: Senior Software Engineer) | Senior Developer, one line | Add stack and work: GitLab CI/CD, PostgreSQL, Hasura, GraphQL, MinIO, Selectel, Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana, Prometheus, Next.js, React, Capacitor/Cordova mobile apps |
| **ELAR** | May – Dec 2014, Programmer | Lead Developer | OK in details; add the АИС «Архив» system for state archives; tags: WinForms, Java, Aspose |
| **Termika** | Apr 2013 – Apr 2014, .NET Programmer | Lead Developer; mentions Selenium and load testing | Keep in line with CV: Production Control for Rosneft and the OLIMPOKS employee certification system (LinkedIn); tags: WPF, Telerik, Stimulsoft, MS SQL. Check Selenium/load testing – not in hh.ru or LinkedIn |
| **Pegas** (pegast.ru, Israel) | Sep 2009 – Mar 2011, Software Developer | Lead Developer | Details OK; add location Tel Aviv; tags: WinForms, DevExpress, MS SQL |
| **AlpOnline** | May 2008 – Aug 2009, Software Developer | Lead Developer | Add: aggregation of tour-operator offers, sync with dozens of the largest Russian tour operators, tour content database |
| **AsgardRo** | Sep 2007 – Apr 2008, Lead Developer | Lead Developer | Add: organized team development, eAthena core, site redesign help; tags: IDA |
| **ArtBridge** | Nov 2006 – Aug 2007, **Web Developer** | **Lead Developer** | Role: Web Developer; tags: HTML/CSS/JS, Excel |
| **LinksPlatform** | Jan 2015 – Jun 2020 (on hh.ru it only fills a gap) | Mar 2010 – present | **Keep as is (2010 – present)**. Excluded from the date check. Details may borrow from hh.ru: bots (VK, Discord, GitHub, trading), web spider into associative storage, Links Notation |

Website-only entries (Deep.GPT, Link.Foundation, Link.Assistant) stay.

**Titles:** the website calls almost every job «Lead Developer». Use the real titles in the CV; the site may show them as given above.

**Details to add for the missing jobs:**

- **Evirma** — Tech Lead, May 2026 – present. AI-driven development of PHP and Go services with Claude Code and Codex; CI/CD automation; a test stand; automated Sentry error fixing with AI; ad campaign scheduling; a Wildberries data parsing service; an AI router that gives agents and staff one access point to AI providers. Roles: `lead`, `ml`, `devops`, `developer`. Tags: PHP, Go, AI agents, CI/CD.
- **Capico LLC** — Senior Software Engineer, Nov 2025 – May 2026. Grid trading system for the ByBit and BitGet exchanges; UI/UX of the trading terminal and other parts of the trading aggregator. Stack: Rust, Vue.js, PostgreSQL, InfluxDB, Redis, TradingView, GitLab CI/CD. Roles: `developer`. 

**Education:** hh.ru says MEPhI (Cybernetics and Information Security), unfinished, 2008. The site says MEPhI 2007–2008 (OK) and MIREA 2015–2016 (not on hh.ru, keep). Add the 2020 course «Digital tools in the modern office» (1C:Document Management). Languages: Russian native, English C1.

**Total experience:** hh.ru says 18 years (it counts from 2006); the site must agree.

## 2. Rule: the site is the full record

- Every job is shown on the site with all its details; the hh.ru CV is a subset.
- On hh.ru, LinksPlatform only fills the 2015–2020 gap; on the site it is 2010 – present.
- Add a data test that fails when a job has no role, dates, summary or tags.

## 3. CV generation

- A «Download CV» action on the home page and the experience page.
- **Tailored:** the CV holds the jobs, skills and summary for the selected position (`/experience/?role=…`), or all experience when none is selected.
- Each job has bullet points (achievements with numbers where known), so a CV can pick the relevant ones per role.
- **Output:** PDF with minimal styling (print CSS + the browser's Save as PDF, or a generated PDF). Text must be selectable and ATS-readable: one column, real text, no images for text.
- Max 2 pages for the tailored CV.
- No private data: no phone, birth date or salary. Contacts: GitHub, Telegram nick, website.

### Styles (at least 3)

1. **Classic** (structure taken from a reference CV, no content copied): name in capitals, title line, location/remote line, contacts line; sections with a thin rule: Profile, Core strengths (labelled groups), Professional experience (company in capitals, dates | location on the right, role line, achievement bullets), Selected products, How I work, Education.
2. **Compact**: one page, a line per job, skills as one block.
3. **Technical**: grouped by stack and projects, with links to repositories and packages.
4. (Optional) **Academic**: research, publications, Links Theory.

All styles use one font family, black text on white in the PDF, and no colors beyond one accent.

## 4. Positions

Existing roles: ML/AI, DevOps, Lead, Developer, Research.
Add positions that match the experience:
- Tech Lead / Team Lead
- CTO / Software Architect
- Backend Developer (Node.js, Rust, Go, PHP, C#)
- Full-stack Developer (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue.js)
- .NET / C# Developer
- Rust Developer
- AI Agents / LLM Engineer
- Trading systems developer (fintech)
- Data Engineer / Database developer (PostgreSQL, Hasura, associative databases)

Each position has: a title in both languages, a summary, the jobs and skills it selects, and its own CV.

## 5. Themes

- Light and dark themes on the site and in the CV preview; follows `prefers-color-scheme` by default, with a switch that is remembered.
- Today `src/index.css` sets `color-scheme: dark` only.
- The PDF is always light (black on white).

## 6. Languages

- English and Russian for the whole site and the CV; detected from the browser, with a switch that is remembered (and `?lang=ru|en` in the URL).
- The CV is generated in the selected language.
- All texts in `profile.js` get both languages (Russian texts can come from the hh.ru CV, English from LinkedIn).
- Company names: the Russian legal names in Russian (ООО «Абракар», АО «ЭЛАР», ЗАО «Термика»…), the English names in English.

## 7. Acceptance

- [ ] Evirma and Capico added; Kaiten, Deep.Foundation, ArtBridge and others fixed as in the table
- [ ] Every hh.ru detail appears on the site (LinksPlatform dates excepted)
- [ ] CV download for all experience and for each position, in EN and RU
- [ ] 3+ CV styles, each printing to a clean PDF of at most 2 pages (tailored)
- [ ] Light/dark themes with auto-detection and a switch
- [ ] EN/RU with auto-detection and a switch
- [ ] New positions listed and selectable on the experience page
- [ ] Tests: data completeness, both languages present for every text, CV render per style/language/position
title: Sync experience with the hh.ru CV; tailored CV in EN/RU, light/dark, several PDF styles, more positions
